title: Your first minutes
summary: A look around the screen: what each part of the HUD tells you and where to start.
text:
You are the colony's caretaker AI. The probe has landed: the **Command Core** is your base, the worker drones build for you, and the **cryo bank** inside the Core holds the embryos of everyone who will ever live here.

Your first job is simple: keep the cryo bank powered, mine alloys and build. The GOALS panel always says what to do next.

- **Build** opens the build menu: start with a Solar Array, then a Mining Depot on an alloy deposit
- Tap a drone, a unit or a building to see what it is doing
- Packs of predators come later: build defences before they do

Tap **Show me around** at the top of the Field Guide to see this tour again.

tour.text: GOALS: what to do next. Each goal ticks off as you do it, and new ones follow.
Build: open the build menu, pick a building and place it near the Command Core. Your drones fly out and build it.
Alloys (◆) pay for everything you build. Mining Depots on alloy deposits bring them in.
Power (⚡): what your buildings make, and what they draw. Solar works by day only.
The battery (🔋) carries you through the night. When it runs dry, the colony browns out.
The cryo bank (❄) holds the embryos. It needs power above all else: if its integrity falls, embryos die.
The clock: day and night come round every few minutes. Nights are dark, and the packs come bigger.
The threat counter (⚠): when the next pack of predators is due.
The radar map: tap or drag it to look somewhere. Red marks are hostiles.
The log: what just happened. Tap a line with ◎ to look at it.
Pause and fast forward. Space pauses too. Take your time: nothing happens while paused.
The menu: save, options, Controls and the Field Guide, with a page on every part of the game. That's it: good luck, caretaker.
